title: prompt-stale-bus
universal_lens: Branch divergence defines a fiber bundle over commit history where each branch is a section with curvature measured by commit-ahead count. The audit map projects sections onto a verification base space (Drive dump) via a classification functor separating research kernels from outreach noise.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats each branch as a latent hypothesis with prior weight proportional to commit-ahead count. The Drive dump check implements a conformal p-value: branches with research content not in dump exceed threshold, triggering epistemic update. Outreach branches collapse to null evidence.
gse_mapping: GSE models branch state as a Markov decision process: states = {unverified, verified-research, verified-outreach, merged}. Transition kernel uses gh-compare as observation operator. The audit writes absorbing state to stale-agent-bus.md, terminating stale branches.

primitives.name: Commit-Ahead Divergence Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Branches ahead of main: - motif/research-push-all (36 ahead, 0 behind) — corpus-intelligence transfers - grok/signal-origin-dm-plan-2026-09-14 (45 ahead) - hermes/wip-local-inventory-2026-09-26 (4 ahead) - hermes/wip-agent-bus-local-clone-2026-09-26 (1 ahead) Use gh compare against main.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \Delta: dimensionless commit count; b: branch identifier; main: reference branch
primitives.assumptions: Linear commit history; no merge commits from main into branch; gh compare accurately reports ahead count
primitives.breakdown_regime: History rewrites (rebase/force-push) invalidate \Delta; merge commits from main create false-zero divergence

layer2.mapping: GSI: \Delta(b) sets prior precision \tau_b \propto \Delta(b) for hypothesis b. GSE: \Delta(b) is state variable in branch-lifecycle MDP; transitions fire when \Delta(b) > \theta_{audit}
layer2.telemetry: gh compare output; commit-graph topology verification

primitives.name: Research vs Outreach Classification Functor
primitives.verbatim_quote: Question: what research, gate, or measured result is on a branch and not on main, and is it already in the Drive dump at G:\.shortcut-targets-by-id\1nCDoFQ9mZ7OPnVSqBl-OeFze3kfqdamG\GSE.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \mathcal{K}: \{-1,0,1\} classification; \mathcal{R}_{\text{research}}: research artifacts; \mathcal{R}_{\text{outreach}}: DM/outreach copy; DriveDump: G:\\...\\GSE
primitives.assumptions: Diff separable into research/outreach; Drive dump is complete snapshot; no private customer data in diff
primitives.breakdown_regime: Mixed diffs (research + outreach) cause ambiguous classification; Drive dump staleness yields false negatives

layer2.mapping: GSI: \mathcal{K}(b)=1 triggers Bayesian update with likelihood L(data|H_b). GSE: \mathcal{K} defines reward function R(s,a) for audit policy; \mathcal{K}=0 branches auto-prune
layer2.telemetry: Drive dump checksum; diff content-type analysis; manual gate review log

primitives.name: Stale-Bus Report Emission Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: it is only outreach or DM copy, say so. Do not copy private customer data into
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \mathcal{E}: classification tuple \to file path; \mathcal{B}: branch set; Markdown: structured text format
primitives.assumptions: Write permission at target path; filesystem atomic write; report consumers parse Markdown
primitives.breakdown_regime: Path length > MAX_PATH; concurrent writes; filesystem full; permission denial

layer2.mapping: GSI: \mathcal{E} publishes posterior summary for meta-inference. GSE: \mathcal{E} is terminal action in audit episode; output becomes observation for downstream automation
layer2.telemetry: File existence + size; parse validation; downstream consumer acknowledgment

primitives.name: Private Data Exclusion Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: it is only outreach or DM copy, say so. Do not copy private customer data into
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \mathcal{S}: \text{string} \to \text{string}; \mathbb{1}: indicator function; PII: personally identifiable information patterns
primitives.assumptions: PII detectable via regex/ML; no false negatives acceptable; report content sanitized pre-write
primitives.breakdown_regime: Obfuscated PII (encoding, fragmentation); novel PII types; adversarial injection

layer2.mapping: GSI: \mathcal{S} enforces likelihood support constraint — private data has zero likelihood under public model. GSE: \mathcal{S} is safety shield action; violation triggers episode termination with penalty
layer2.telemetry: PII scan pass rate; false positive audit; compliance log

The branch audit defines a sheaf over the commit DAG: each branch b is a stalk with data \Delta(b) (divergence) and \mathcal{K}(b) (knowledge type). The restriction map to main is the gh-compare diff. The global section existence problem — does a unified research state exist across branches? — reduces to checking \mathcal{K}(b)=1 branches against the Drive dump base space. The emission operator \mathcal{E} assembles the cokernel of the restriction map into a Markdown cocycle. The sanitization gate \mathcal{S} is a Grothendieck topology covering sieve: only PII-free opens admit sections. Failure modes: (1) \Delta mismeasurement under rebase (non-flat connection), (2) \mathcal{K} ambiguity on mixed diffs (non-separated presheaf), (3) \mathcal{E} path collision (non-Hausdorff base), (4) \mathcal{S} evasion (sieve not covering). Dualities: divergence \leftrightarrow convergence (PR merge), research \leftrightarrow outreach (signal/noise), local \leftrightarrow Drive (cache/authority).
